title: Draft: UFO Hypothesis and Survival Questions, January 1, 1968
doc_notes: This document is a 1968 NSA draft monograph discussing the survival implications of various UFO hypotheses, including hoaxes, hallucinations, natural phenomena, secret projects, and extraterrestrial intelligence.
